# Checking searchedName with scientificName (use this for test)
- White space cleaning!
- Genus
- And Non genus pass
```{python}
import re
# df['searchedName'] != df['scientificName'].str.apply(lambda x: x.srip.split(' ')[0])
df2['scientificName'] = df2['formattedName'].map(lambda x: ' '.join(re.findall(r"<i>(.*?)</i>",x)))

df2['first_of_searched'] = df2['searchedName'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().split(' ')[0])
df2['first_of_binomial'] = df2['scientificName'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().split(' ')[0])
df2['first_of_canonical'] = df2['canonicalName'].apply(lambda x: x.strip().split(' ')[0])
mask1= (df2['first_of_searched']!=df2['first_of_canonical'])
mask2= (df2['first_of_binomial']!=df2['first_of_canonical'])
mask3 = (df2['rank']=='GENUS')
# df2[mask1 & mask3].head(20)
df2[mask1].head(20)
# display(df2[df2['first_of_binomial']!=df2['first_of_canonical']])
```
